privileged_info_for_vlm: The required cache time is 86400 seconds (24 hours). The attribution title must be 'Provided by Natural Earth'. The logo URL is 'http://localhost:8080/geoserver/ne_logo.png' with type 'image/png' and dimensions 88x31. These settings are located under the 'Publishing' tab of the layer configuration in GeoServer.
